Two categorical outcomes encode the same row at different granularity: 'num' (5 ordered grades 0-4) and 'heart_disease_binary' (0 = no disease, 1 = any grade 1-4), where the coarser level is a deterministic function of the finer one. Per the multilabel rule these are joint outcomes, so both are targets rather than one being a leakage suspect of the other.
